author: director
purpose: Resolution-quality corpus for MP-3. MP-3 replaces aiBuildSmartQueries + aiChooseBestFoodCandidate with a deterministic scorer over SmartFoodSearch3. Call count is NOT the risk — relevance is. This corpus is the guard: it proves the deterministic scorer picks foods a human would accept, with no model and no device.
howToUse: For each case, run the concept name through the MP-3 resolver against the shipped 14,484-row catalogue. The resolved food's name must match at least one pattern in mustMatchAny (case-insensitive substring, all tokens of a multi-token pattern present) and must match NO pattern in mustNotMatch. Report per-case PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED. UNRESOLVED means the resolver returned nothing — report it, do not treat it as a pass.
rules: Executors may ADD cases. Executors may NOT delete or weaken a case to make a gate pass.
A case that cannot be satisfied is a stop-and-report event and a finding about the scorer, not a bad case.
mustNotMatch is the important half: it encodes the wrong-but-plausible matches a naive lexical scorer will make.
Where the catalogue genuinely lacks a good match, UNRESOLVED is the correct and honest outcome. Do not force a poor match to avoid it.
